title: தாயாருக்கு கண்டம் / ஆயுள் (Mother's Longevity & Critical Phases)
description: 4th lord + Moon placed at Rahu-Ketu midpoint or in trine with Rahu/Ketu indicates critical health phases or danger for mother, unless saved by strong Sthana Balam or benefic aspect.

title: தந்தைக்கு கண்டம் / ஆயுள் (Father's Longevity & Critical Phases)
description: 9th lord + Sun placed at Rahu-Ketu midpoint or in mutual trine/conjunction with Rahu/Ketu in Dasa operating indicates severe affliction to father.

title: தாய் தந்தை இல்லாத அனாதை யோகம் (Loss of Parents / Raised by Relatives)
description: 4th and 9th houses afflicted by Rahu, Ketu, and Saturn along with weak/debilitated Sun and Moon causes loss of parental care, leading to being raised by relatives or institutions.
